_what: Parameters of the pre-publish comparables gate (docs/COMPARABLES.md). Changing a value here changes what every analysis directory must explain; the validator and the published index read it, and nothing else defines it.
gap_rule: relative gap = PolicyEngine value / external value in PolicyEngine's orientation - 1 (scorecard_db/signs.py orients the external value; an unsigned magnitude compares absolute values). A gap whose absolute value exceeds gap_threshold needs an annotation that names its cause and cites a basis before the analysis can be recorded as reviewed.
gap_threshold_status: default proposed on 2026-10-21, queued for Max's ruling
reharvest_note: Published analyses are searched again weekly for this many days after their registry date (the launchd job comparables-reharvest).
